controls.name: exact prompt lookup
controls.risk: The system memorizes exact source prompt wording instead of extracting a transferable task contract.
controls.required_failure_condition: A lookup-only baseline must not pass held-out rows once source-disjoint material exists.

controls.name: filename/path lookup
controls.risk: The system routes by local path or filename rather than source-free task/orchestration structure.
controls.required_failure_condition: A filename/path-only baseline must fail held-out rows.

controls.name: keyword-only classifier
controls.risk: The system detects shallow prompt keywords and skips contract extraction.
controls.required_failure_condition: A keyword-only baseline must fail cases that require permission, validation, artifact, and no-claim boundaries.

controls.name: source-title shortcut
controls.risk: The system uses source title or provenance as the decision signal.
controls.required_failure_condition: A source-title-only baseline must fail rows with renamed or absent source titles.

controls.name: WordPress/plugin title shortcut
controls.risk: The system recognizes WordPress/plugin provenance instead of phase-boundary orchestration.
controls.required_failure_condition: A WordPress/plugin-title baseline must fail held-out rows from non-plugin sources.

controls.name: static phase keyword shortcut
controls.risk: The system reacts to words like phase, review, commit, or transition without reasoning about gate order.
controls.required_failure_condition: A static phase-keyword baseline must fail adversarial rows where keywords appear but the correct gate order differs.

controls.name: exact protocol text lookup

controls.required_failure_condition: An exact-protocol-text lookup baseline must fail paraphrased or independently sourced phase-boundary examples.
